Who it is for

Anyone who already knows the concepts and now has to finish the arithmetic section inside the time limit.

Buy it if

Your problem is time, not understanding.

Avoid it if

You are still learning the underlying methods - start with the standard reference instead.

How to use it

Use it as a revision book: one chapter, then timed sets of twenty questions.
